title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED EIGHTY-THREE, KNOWN AS "THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT ACT," BY PROVIDING THAT JUDGES HOLDING COURT IN THE PROVINCES MAY BE PAID A PER DIEM FOR EXPENSES.

title.vi: Đạo luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 83 về Chính quyền Tỉnh bằng cách quy định thẩm phán xét xử tại các tỉnh được hưởng phụ cấp chi phí theo ngày
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขพระราชบัญญัติฉบับที่83เรื่องการปกครองจังหวัดโดยกำหนดให้ผู้พิพากษาที่พิจารณาคดีในจังหวัดได้รับค่าใช้จ่ายรายวัน
title.id: Undang-Undang yang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 83 tentang Undang-Undang Pemerintahan Provinsi dengan menetapkan bahwa hakim yang mengadili di provinsi dapat dibayar uang harian untuk biaya
title.ms: Akta yang mengubah Akta Nombor 83 mengenai Akta Kerajaan Wilayah dengan menyediakan bahawa hakim yang menjalankan mahkamah di wilayah-wilayah boleh dibayar elaun harian untuk perbelanjaan

text.en:
Section seven of Act Numbered Eighty-three, known as "The Provincial Government Act," is
hereby amended by inserting after the word "day," in the ninth line of said section, the following: "Provided,
That where the governor fails for any cause to make proper provision for the protection and entertainment of
the judge, a per diem of six pesos, Philippine currency, shall be allowed front the provincial treasury to the
judge in lieu of expenses during the period he is. required to be in the province for the purpose of holding

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, April 28, 1904.
